# Strategic Finance LLC

> Fractional CFO practice based in Charleston, SC, founded by Tom Schipper in 2021. Serves owner-led and investor-backed companies across the Southeast with ongoing CFO leadership: not a one-time project, not bookkeeping alone.

Tom Schipper has more than 20 years in FP&A, controllership, and CFO roles across SaaS, healthcare, manufacturing, telecom, and global operations, including Americas Controller at BT Global Services, planning roles at PepsiCo, and senior controller at Volvo Cars' Charleston plant. He also co-founded a SaaS business intelligence company (Querri) as CFO. He holds an MBA in Finance and Operations from Texas A&M (Mays Business School) and a post-graduate certificate in AI and Machine Learning from UT McCombs, and is a Certified QuickBooks ProAdvisor, Gold tier.

Strategic Finance handles the finance function end to end, from the bookkeeping foundation up through strategic decision support, as one accountable owner rather than splitting bookkeeping and CFO advisory across separate vendors. Bookkeeping is never offered as a standalone service; cleanup is built into every CFO engagement, not billed separately. All work happens inside the client's own QuickBooks Online, so the books stay the client's if the engagement ever changes. AI is used to deliver faster and more accurately, but every output is reviewed by the CFO before it reaches a client, lender, or investor.

## Clients

Current and recent engagements include Trusted Results Therapy Group (multi-location mental health therapy practice), Amplio Spine (medical device, FDA-cleared spine implant commercialization), Juiced Fuel (multi-unit franchise brand), and Querri (SaaS business intelligence, Tom's prior CFO role as co-founder).
